show.name: Седьмой игрок
show.summary:
"Stroitel" club was once a successful team, and its owner dreamed of one day having the chance to move beyond its current league and earn a place in the KHL. But the players and coaching staff have fallen into a deep slump, leaving the team at the bottom of the standings with no way out. Now, it seems easier to shut down the club and its arena altogether. Losing faith in the team's chances of turning things around on the ice, "Stroitel's" owner appoints a figure skating coach as the club's director.

The club's survival now depends on whether the former skater can unite the players, forge a bond between the team and its fans, who are considered the equivalent of a sixth player on the ice, and become the club's "seventh player" by finding success from behind the management desk.

show.name: Shixiong A Shixiong
show.summary:
After being reborn in ancient times before the Great God-Conferment War, Li Changshou became a small cultivator.

To survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tries hard not to accumulate any karma. He always plans thoroughly before doing anything and never allows himself to walk into dangerous situations. He hides his trump cards well, trains himself in escape techniques, refines poisonous pills, and masters mystical abilities.
Li Changshou originally planned to remain hidden and safe in the mountain until his ascension to immortality. However, everything changed one year when his master brought home a junior sister…

After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .

A two-way journey that began in their youth finally comes full circle, bringing them both a chance to heal.

show.summary: Forensic scientist-turned-chef Chan becomes the prime suspect in his rival chef's mysterious death. He must clear his name, using his deep knowledge of food chemistry and forensic science, and teaming up with fearless investigative police officer Lieutenant Lalit whose past intertwines with his own. Together, they tackle intriguing cases through culinary experiments and create mouth-watering dishes.

body.summary: Linda vows to support Lee. Nancy finds herself asking Johnny for support. Lauren gets overwhelmed by her feelings.

show.name: EastEnders
show.summary:
Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. 

Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

body.name: Episode 1
body.summary: Philomena Cunk's groundbreaking history of cinema begins. Cunk meets Hollywood legends and interrogates the writer of Die Hard, as she starts her quest deep, deep into cinema. She witnesses the shockingly poor picture quality of the earliest films and marvels at the beards of their Victorian inventors; she gasps audibly at the invention of sound; and she critiques some of the supposedly finest creations of Hollywood's Golden Age. Along the way she interviews filmmakers, actors and critics, including several you've definitely heard of, and she (and you) finally discovers the true meaning of The Wizard of Oz.

show.name: Cunk on Cinema
show.summary: Philomena Cunk will be asking experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to the entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

body.name: Episode 2
body.summary:
Philomena Cunk continues her epic journey deep, deep into film. She interrogates some of the world's foremost filmmakers and critics, discovers an age of screen icons from Marilyn Monroe to Wayne John, and learns how Hollywood movies changed as American social values relaxed; and how, believe it or not, other countries were making films as well.

Along the way, she gives her verdict on classics like Jaws, Taxi Driver, and Citizen Ken - very much the ‘Citizen Kane' of films about people called Ken.

body.name: Episode 3
body.summary:
Philomena Cunk heads to Hollywood for the final part of her staggeringly comprehensive history of cinema, where she accosts some of the people behind the biggest movies of recent years, from The Avengers to Transformers to the Flintstones film.

She takes a look at Star Wars, Jurassic Park, Toy Story, the home video revolution, the rise of the blockbuster franchise and the state of cinema today. And with the rise of artificial intelligence, she asks the question: is Hollywood finished... or just about to be finished?

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: Target
show.summary: Mark is a high school student at an elite school, whose carefree life ends one day: his beloved girlfriend Ailin becomes distant with zero explanation. At the same time, Mark begins to see strange targeted messages on his social media feed, which seem to be messages from the future as they describe events that begin to happen in real life. When he receives a "target" predicting that a life-threatening fire will break out at the school, he realizes he must act. Now, Mark needs not only to figure out his relationship with Ailin, but also to prevent a catastrophe by finding the arsonist. Having managed to convince his peers that the danger is real, they set out to prevent a catastrophe.

Now he cultivates in the Jadeon Sect, his knowledge and possession will draw him into a chaotic story where he will have to carry some of the greatest burdens of the Martial World.

show.name: When I Meet the Moon
show.summary: The socially anxious Yun Li applies for a postgraduate program in Nanwu to prove her independence to her father. A day before the semester begins, she is invited to a local virtual reality (VR) center as a video creator. There, she reunites with Fu Shize, the genius and her high school crush. She gradually opens up, and, with the help of others, goes all out to court her dream man, winning him over with her warmth and radiance. However, amid the loving moments, their differing perspectives eventually lead to a breakup. When she goes abroad, his deeply suppressed trauma is brought to the forefront. To win her back, he gets back on his feet, leading his team to new heights in scientific research. When she returns to China, he pursues her relentlessly, and the two overcome their differences and rekindle their love.

To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film "The Rose" as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate.

show.summary: The show "Traitors" is an adaptation of the world hit The Traitors. The Ukrainian reality show features 22 participants competing for half a million hryvnias. Among them are "loyal" and "traitors". The task of the "loyal" is to expose the traitors, and the traitors - to reach the final. The action takes place in the Schönborn castle.

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

show.name: Die Kaiserin
show.summary: When the rebellious Elisabeth ("Sisi") meets Franz, the Emperor of Austria, the young couple's intoxicating love completely upsets the power structure at the Viennese court. After the wedding, the young empress must assert herself not only against her mother-in-law, the sovereign, power-hungry Sophie but also against Franz's brother Maxi, who himself longs for the throne (and for Sisi). As enemy troops form upon the borders of the Habsburg Empire, people in Vienna rise up in protest against the emperor. Elisabeth must find out who she can trust and how high the price is to be a true empress and a figure of hope for the people.

show.name: Alchemy Supreme
show.summary: In the ancient continent of medicine, countless races coexist, with alchemists revered. The Yin-Yang Alchemy God, Su Beihuang, poured his heart and soul into refining the Divine Pill, only to be betrayed by a beautiful woman and become one with the pill, hiding for a century. A hundred years later, his descendant, Su Beitian, suffers humiliation but resists fiercely, unexpectedly inheriting the Alchemy God's legacy and returning with overwhelming power! Awakening his dual-elemental martial veins of ice and fire, he re-cultivates the Alchemy God's techniques, becoming a young hero. As he investigates the truth behind his mother's disappearance, a series of conspiracies gradually surface. Witness Su Beitian overcome tribulations, unravel the ultimate martial arts, and become the supreme master of alchemy!

show.summary: Aussie Shore follows the wild antics of a group of young and rowdy housemates as they work hard, and party even harder whilst navigating the highs and lows of living together 24/7 in the non-stop party town of Cairns.

show.summary: Celebrity couple Khaled Saqer and Elham Ali host this social experiment, where Arab singles connect and commit to marriage — before meeting face-to-face.

show.summary: Based on the #1 NYT bestselling series by J.R. Ward, the league of vampire warriors known as the Black Dagger Brotherhood must fight against the Lessening Society to protect their race from extinction.

show.name: American Pulse
show.summary: American Pulse is an hour showcasing reporting from the vast network of CNN affiliates across the country.

show.name: Critical Role Cooldown
show.summary: Get a backstage pass to a Critical Role episode. You'll be right there at the table immediately after Matt says "Is it Thursday yet?", experiencing the cast's post-show reactions. Share in the tumult of theories, the chaos of questions, and the pitching of plans from the cast after the show. If you've ever wondered what lies just beyond the curtain, this is your chance to find out. Starting with Campaign 3, Episode 83, you'll get instant access to 10 episodes with new episodes dropping every Thursday with each new Critical Role episode.

show.name: BattleBots Pro League
show.summary: BattleBots Pro League powered by Bright Data is the toughest robot combat event on the planet. 24 elite bots from across the globe converge on Las Vegas for the ultimate fight to the death. There are 6 Groups of 4 bots, each of which has to fight everyone in the Group. The Group winners progress to the Knockout rounds, so every fight matters and there are no second chances.

show.name: Fool in Love
show.summary: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

show.name: Till I See You
show.summary: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly ""see"" each other, they have already fallen in love. But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?

show.name: Miracles of the ER
show.summary: At Yang-Da University Hospital, Associate Director of Emergency Medicine Chou Cheng-chun makes a bold decision to accept Lin Geng-ming, an average-performing medical school graduate. Lin joins the emergency department as a resident alongside elite peers, Tang Hsi and Chiang Tung-yen, working shoulder to shoulder to save lives. Together with senior attending physician He Yu-hua, the ER team faces relentless medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and internal power struggles within the hospital. Miracles of the ER delves into the complex dynamics between doctors and patients, patients and their families, revealing both the tension and the deep compassion that bind them all together.

Lin joins the emergency department as a resident alongside elite peers, Tang Hsi and Chiang Tung-yen, working shoulder to shoulder to save lives. Together with senior attending physician He Yu-hua, the ER team faces relentless medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and internal power struggles within the hospital. Miracles of the ER delves into the complex dynamics between doctors and patients, patients and their families, revealing both the tension and the deep compassion that bind them all together.

show.name: Second Plate
show.summary:
Kang Yu Hyeon once dreamed of becoming a chef and entered culinary school with complete confidence in his abilities. However, after meeting his exceptionally talented junior, O Min Gyeom, he is forced to confront a level of skill he cannot surpass. Unable to come to terms with the gap between them, Yu Hyeon gives up on his dream and drops out of university. 

Years later, Yu Hyeon is living an ordinary life as a product developer at a food company. Just when he thinks the past is behind him, he reunites with Min Gyeom, who has become a renowned chef, when the two are assigned to collaborate on the development of a new product.

As old wounds resurface and lingering feelings refuse to fade, the reunion challenges both men to face the past they never truly left behind.

show.name: Love on Hire
show.summary: Thitinan will take any job—being a fake girlfriend and breaking up a relationship, or, special just for Miss Chat, becoming a bedroom coach.

show.name: The Chemistry

show.summary: Twenty years after the murder of the Mexican regional music icon, the production reconstructs the hours that shaped his story and revisits the questions that, two decades later, remain unanswered.

show.name: Eigyou Desukara
show.summary:
In order to be pampered by girls, Ren has been "Selling BL" (fanservice) by flirting with Issei, a handsome guy who attends the same college. But one day, Ren is suddenly kissed by Issei?!

A fascinating love comedy that begins with a lie.

show.name: Days of Our Lives
show.summary:
Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama.

Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.

show.summary: Voice actor Matthew Mercer leads a group of fellow voice actors on epic Dungeons & Dragons campaigns. These familiar voices bring the audience into the full experience of D&D, allowing imaginations to soar as the characters embark on adventures. This is Critical Role!

show.name: The Kardashians
show.summary: Just when you think life can't get any faster in the Kardashian-Jenner family, they punch it into overdrive. From the big screen to baby bliss, the family continues to defy expectations in all their endeavors. Cameras roll as Kourtney, Kim, Khloé, Kendall, and Kylie navigate contentious sister dynamics, all under the watchful eye of everyone's favorite matriarch, Kris.

show.name: The Good Daughter
show.summary: The Good Daughter is a suspenseful crime drama where sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she's forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

show.name: Blue Skies
show.summary:
Blue Skies is an all-new procedural series blending mystery, action, and emotional storytelling, centered on the powerful bond between a detective and her canine companion.

Set in the stunning Crystal Ridge National Park, the series follows former military police officer Jodi Larsen as she returns to her hometown to serve as a criminal investigator for the National Park Police. As Jodi protects the park and its visitors from both natural and human threats, she navigates a new team, personal loss, and an unexpected partnership with Blue, a mischievous stray Labrador whose instincts prove invaluable in solving cases.

The canine, Blue, a golden Labrador Retriever is played by three brothers, River, Comet and Canyon. River is considered the "star" of the three.

show.name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
show.summary: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.
